manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0030; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: “This time, I read.” is understandable and natural in the explicit turn-taking context; “This time, I read books.” is a simple controlled transfer.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian renders this time as این بار and keeps read as the already-known action without adding a false tense contrast.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors separate current turn-taking from unrelated preference or partner actions.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: A short two-word time frame is added to known I + read language, appropriate for this A1 point.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The learner recognizes “This time” in a short clause and retrieves it again with the longer familiar object “books.”

overallCoherence.evidence: Every activity reinforces the changed-turn meaning and culminates in hidden retrieval with the same target expression.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Review is limited to the bounded A1 outcome encoded in this Lesson and does not claim mastery beyond that scope.
Final ElevenLabs prosody and speech-recognition behavior remain unreviewed until the text gate passes.
Quality v3 remediation was model/editor reviewed; real learner evidence is still required before public-release readiness.
resolvedFindings: English dialogue and target construction are contextually natural for the declared scenario.
Persian learner-facing meaning preserves the intended bounded sense without promoting a compositional phrase to a lexical word.
The final activity requires hidden retrieval and changes or extends context enough to provide transfer evidence.
Character/story continuity and learner-role assignment are consistent with the declared story metadata.
Quality v3: dialogue exposure, duplicate scoring, safe speech equivalence and grounded story copy rechecked after deterministic remediation.
